from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u030/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=programs/'task-3a9410fc.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    clues = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    # The clues lie on parallel diagonals; choose the orientation with fewer
    # distinct diagonal lines. The first projection is the NW-SE direction.
    projections = [lambda r, c: c - r, lambda r, c: c + r]
    values = [[proj(r, c) for r, c, _ in clues] for proj in projections]
    which = min(range(2), key=lambda i: len(set(values[i])))
    coords = values[which]
    period = None
    palette = None
    for p in range(1, max(rows, cols) + 1):
        trial = {}
        valid = True
        for (_, _, color), x in zip(clues, coords):
            phase = x % p
            if phase in trial and trial[phase] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            trial[phase] = color
        if valid:
            period, palette = p, trial
            break
    out = []
    proj = projections[which]
    for r in range(rows):
        out.append([palette.get(proj(r, c) % period, 0) for c in range(cols)])
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
